name: Bully's East Prime Bistro Sports Bar
notes: Same SpotHopper widget pattern as other spotapps.co sites in this batch, served directly on the restaurant's own domain and readable by plain curl. Address on the page (2401 Camino Del Rio South, San Diego, CA 92108) matches the work list. Five tabs, all embedded in one document: Appetizers, Brunch, Lunch/Dinner (Prime Rib, Seafood, Steaks, Burgers & Sandwiches, Bully's Classics, Salads, Sides), Desserts, and Happy Hour (its own discounted Drinks and Appetizers subsections -- kept separate since several items, e.g. Shrimp Ceviche $16 regular vs $8 happy hour, Chips & Guacamole $13 vs $6, carry two real, different prices depending on which menu they're ordered from; not merged or averaged). Two items are priced by size, both real read prices: Abalone Fillet (3oz $64.00 / 6oz $109.00) and The Bully Burger (base $21.00 / with cheese $23.00). No Market-Price or unpriced items encountered this time. Markup test not applicable (first-party restaurant site). Did not check the separate '/order-prime-rib' page since Prime Rib already appears priced within the Lunch/Dinner tab.

name: Tartine
notes: Restaurant's own WordPress/Elementor site (Jet Price List widget), address-confirmed 1106 First St., Coronado (matches work-list '1106 1st St'). Sections: Breakfast (Breakfast, All Day), Lunch (Salads, Sandwiches), Dinner, and Special Orders (advance-order whole cakes/tortes/quiche). Two Dinner items (Fresh Seafood of the Day, Chicken of the Day) show only a bare '$' with no number and were dropped per the no-price rule. Special Orders items list 2-3 sizes as slash-separated whole-dollar numbers (e.g. '44/54/64'); every item's description states the corresponding sizes explicitly (e.g. 'Available in sizes 6"/8"/10"'), so each size was split into its own dish row with the size in the name - all values read directly from the source, none derived or averaged. Wine and Beverages sections carry only descriptive text with no per-item prices anywhere on the page (confirmed genuinely unpriced, not a missed read) and were excluded; 'Daily Specials' is a one-line seasonal disclaimer with no items. Markup test: 56 of 64 prices are whole dollars, rest end .25/.50 - clean, no fee pattern.
